data.name: Desktop Mart
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Desktop Mart — a tiny, cozy supermarket that lives on your desktop.

You're the manager of a small corner supermarket. Customers wander in, browse the shelves, pick what they need, and pay at the register — while your staff keeps everything stocked and running. Just set it up and let the little world hum along beside your work.

🏗️ Build your dream store

  • Arrange shelves, freezers and the cash register freely on a grid — rotate, move, and recycle at any time

  • Unlock more goods: bread, boxed goods, chilled drinks, bagged goods and more

  • Every shelf has real stock — watch your inventory visually fill and empty

👥 A living little world

  • Customers have their own needs and interest tags, browse with personality, and rate their visit

  • Staff AI auto-restocks and runs the register, with switchable work strategies

📈 Grow your business

  • Track sales stats, best-sellers, customer satisfaction and your 1–5 star store rating

  • Milestone missions drive your progress with permanent multipliers and unlocks

  • Train your staff and equip them with affix bonuses (move speed, restock speed, checkout speed…)

🪟 Made for your second screen

  • A compact 600×600 window that can always stay on top

  • UI appears only when you hover — pure desktop companion mode

  • No timers nagging you to come back; check in whenever you like

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 compatible GPU (Intel UHD 620+)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz quad-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 discrete GPU (GTX 960+)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DX compatible sound card
